description: This file defines the 'DB' class in the Opencart PHP framework, which acts as a database adaptor handling connection initialization, query execution, escaping, and status checks. It encapsulates the logic to load database engine classes dynamically and provides a unified interface for database operations.

classes.name: DB
classes.description: A database adaptor class that manages database connections and queries by dynamically loading specific database engine classes based on configuration.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the database connection by validating required parameters, loading the appropriate database engine class, and instantiating it.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Executes an SQL query through the loaded database adaptor.

methods.name: escape
methods.description: Escapes a string for safe inclusion in SQL queries.

methods.name: countAffected
methods.description: Returns the number of rows affected by the last query.

methods.name: getLastId
methods.description: Retrieves the last inserted ID after an insert operation.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Checks if the database connection is active.
